segments.content:
0202 Legends of the Three Kingdoms Continues its Overseas Expansion (Page 1/2)

But they discovered that this courtroom was airtight, without even a single window. This was to prevent prisoners from escaping. So if they wanted to leave, their only option was the main gate behind them. Yet, that main gate was surrounded by a throng of government soldiers.

With the high salary, many people applied. Lingxue Jie had only ever worked for others, never been a boss, but she hired whoever came to apply. She gave them a two-month probation period; after all, the probationary salaries for all these people were less than her interest income for a single day.

The next moment, a deafening sound that shook the heavens and the earth erupted. Then, under everyone's horrified gazes, eighty-one chaotic worlds shattered with a thunderous crash.

It turned out we had nothing left to say to each other. Although I tried to make small talk with Huang Xin to keep the atmosphere from getting too awkward, her response remained very cold.

"Dear Dragon Lord, thank you for your reminder. It saved me from leading my country and people to eternal damnation for the wrong goal." John Oyegun was indeed very fortunate. He was a smart man, and the more he thought about it, the more he knew his decision was correct.

The scenery was beautiful, and everyone was rather surprised. No one had expected a problem to occur during the descent onto the mountain.

He suddenly lifted the robes on his body. The moment Zhu Shaofeng glanced over, he nearly spat out the red wine he had just drunk.

"You should still go to the hospital to get it checked, don't be careless." Qin Su was worried and called for Old Chen to prepare the car, ready to go to the hospital.

"Are you trying to tickle me? Or did you grow up eating congee?" Du Jinshan taunted him mercilessly.

Lin Yinan's question was abrupt, and Zhong Yue's eyelid twitched. Lin Yinan hadn't asked this question since he returned from England, so Zhong Yue had assumed he had already asked Lin Xi. His sudden question today caught Zhong Yue completely unprepared.

Sounds of cracking emanated from the walls inside the room, and all the images were on the verge of disappearing.

Presumably, Chen Qianliang wouldn't do that either, so he would definitely come out. And that would be the day he died.

She had an "I knew it" look on her face. This bastard was always doing things that were troublesome. If it were her, she would just go up and kill the person. So much dawdling and pointless chatter.

Of course, this matter could be implemented because Yao Fa had been doing it this way from the very beginning. At that time, it was all his clones, so he could do whatever he wanted.

Chunzhen drew a number plate. Looking at the match-up chart, he found that if he kept winning, he would have to fight three rounds. If he lost, he would be eliminated immediately.

Fudge did have some skills, managing to arrange such a meticulous plan in just a few short days.

He even saw Shan Qi place a hand on his own ring, ready to be silenced at the slightest misstep.

Just then, the man in black suddenly felt a cold sensation on his arm, immediately followed by an excruciating, tearing pain.

Perhaps genuinely worried about being caught in the crossfire, everyone tacitly dropped the subject and started chatting casually about daily neighborhood matters.

That person's martial arts were about on par with Nangong Liuyun's, but from the moment he stepped out, a faint, ethereal aura had been rising from his body.

Douya couldn't help but shiver, her eyes losing focus, and even her round shoulders slumped.

The neighbors on this street had all witnessed this. Some had even advised the Zhang family to just forget it and stop caring. It looked like she wasn't going to survive anyway. Might as well just let her be dragged down to her death.

Wang Jingze also got a clear look at Wang Yue at this moment. Although they hadn't seen each other for half a year and Wang Yue's hair was cut shorter, he still recognized him.

The struggles of large families have always been like this, especially for families that rose up from the underworld. They had risen through blood and fire to begin with.

Lin Chuxia sat by the window, staring blankly outside. It had all happened too suddenly, and Lin Chuxia still felt dazed. But Luo Yichen's face was vividly before her eyes. He called her "baby." Why?

His father's mood didn't seem too bad. He would just daze off for long periods, or gaze at his late wife's photo, stroking it while muttering to himself, expressing his feelings.

"How is that possible? We'd be lucky if the Palace of Petty Officers even let us in to ask a few questions." The two discussed as they walked slowly towards the Palace of Petty Officers. But just then, they saw a sedan chair appear ahead.

"Alright then, I'll drink and watch you perform." Old Man Liu had only heard from Ma Shaofen that Da Ai was exceptionally gifted in the performing arts; he had never seen Da Ai perform himself.

"Then can I see Xia Xia one more time before I leave? When will she be back?" All along, his mentor's words had been like a holy decree. Indeed, he knew this was a rare opportunity. If it weren't for Lin Chuxia, he would have no hesitation and would have chosen to work abroad without a second thought.

Li Wei was already overjoyed that he could come today. If Li Wei left, what was the point of her inviting these other people?

He suddenly opened his eyes, startling me so much that my first instinct was to pull my hand back. After all, Jian Lihua and I had always been at each other's throats. Even if he was sick now, he probably didn't want me to touch him, right? After all, he despised me so much.

The moment Tan Zongming heard this, his portly body immediately shot up and "whooshed" away. Even though he and Wei Guoqiang were mutually unwilling to offend each other, being caught between these two today was definitely not a good thing.

More and more nurses came in with blood bags. The various instruments beeped incessantly. If a short "beep" turned into a long "beeeeep," it would mean the surgery had failed, that Luo Ange would never wake up again.
